title: Follow
wikitext:
{{Infobox command |image= |creator=qqshka |year=8th March 2009 |type=command |sort=qtv }} Enables observer to follow someone else's pov changes. Mainly created to follow commentators. Works with both player {{abbr|nick|/name}} and {{abbr|ID|use /qtvusers to se ID}}. If you're 2 commentatators, one can follow the other and your points of view will be in sync. ==Usage== follow 'nick'/ID ===Example=== follow bps follow 229 ==Note== Only works when connected to [[QTV]]. (Doesn't work as ordinary spectator) ==Trivia== If you follow yourself (either by nick or ID), you'll get the following message: 
Huh? You can't follow yourself.
